examples.subject: A question about TPC’s press and welding work
examples.basis: Official profile documents presses, fabrication and robotic welding. Client logos include TAFE and Rane; logos are company claims, not independently confirmed current contracts.
examples.body:
Hi Sharath,

I saw that TPC combines press work, fabrication and robotic welding for tractor and automotive components.

I’m building Kenesis Vision. We’re testing whether existing CCTV can help explain production delays that are difficult to reconstruct afterwards.

When a batch waits between operations, how does your team work out what held it up? Or is that already covered by your production records?

We’re choosing our first repeatable product. A brief reply about one gap would help us decide what is worth building.

[Your name]
Kenesis Vision

examples.subject: How does Varna review interruptions across shifts?
examples.basis: Official page states digital printing on woven/knit fabrics, three shifts and Ranganath’s operational role. Companies in his biography are former employers, not established Varna clients.
examples.body:
Hi Ranganath,

I read that Varna prints both woven and knit fabrics and runs three shifts. Your site says you oversee operations.

When output is below plan, can you trace the interruption across those shifts from your current records?

At Kenesis Vision, we’re testing AI on existing CCTV to make visible production events easier to review. We’re still deciding which factory problem to build a repeatable product around.

What, if anything, is hard to reconstruct at Varna today? A short reply is enough.

[Your name]
Kenesis Vision

examples.subject: A question about Shahi’s Uthukottai factory
examples.basis: Official contact page separates the Uthukottai factory from Koyambedu office. Product range is appalam/pappadum. No unverified named client is used.
examples.body:
Hello Shahi Foods team,

Could you pass this to the owner or production manager? I saw that your factory is in Uthukottai and your office is in Koyambedu.

I’m building Kenesis Vision. We’re testing whether existing CCTV can help answer production questions without someone replaying hours of footage.

Is there a recurring factory issue that your team currently has to visit or phone the floor to understand?

We’re choosing our first repeatable product. One example would help us judge whether video could be useful.

[Your name]
Kenesis Vision
